title: pairLookup operation
description: ONE TOOL CALL, ONE EVIDENCE CARD for a binary: what the installation catalogue holds for the pair, in a fixed byte budget (2048 bytes). The honesty ladder: a curated catalogue pair record (paste-ready `source` entry, validity, provenance) -> Choupo's own regression (`fittedInCase`, verdict) -> UNIFAC, said to be an ESTIMATE with its measured warning -> 'I do not have this pair' and what the student can bring. Never a number invented; the fields the C16 chain will add are listed as announced-absent. Reads the installation catalogue, not the case's constant/.
